# indykite_audit_signings (Data Source)

List Audit Signing configurations in the given Application Space, filtered by exact name match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "indykite_audit_signings" "example" {
  app_space_id = indykite_application_space.my_space.id
  filter       = ["terraform-audit-signing"]
}

output "audit_signing_provider" {
  value = data.indykite_audit_signings.example.audit_signings[0].key_provider
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_space_id` (String) Identifier of Application Space
- `filter` (List of String) Filter resources based on given names. Using 'exact name match' strategy to find entries.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `audit_signings` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit_signings))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
